user.title: Connect to OpenModem
user.description: Enter the LAN IP address of the RM520N-GL modem running OpenModem (the same address you use for its web UI).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to OpenModem at that address/port.
error.timeout: Timed out waiting for a response from OpenModem.
error.unexpected_response: Connected, but the response didn't look like ha_state.sh's expected JSON. Is OpenModem up to date?
